name: Itakura Shuzo
about: Itakura Shuzo has brewed in Izumo, Shimane, since 1871. The name Tenon was given in 1916 by the head priest of a Nichiren temple, taken from a Buddhist phrase meaning a calm sky and peace for the world.

The brewery makes sake in the San'in ginjo style of the Izumo toji. This means limited rice soaking, a koji with mould spread through the centre of the grain, and long cold fermentation. Mukyu Tenon is a second label, and the brewery keeps machine work to a minimum.
